analyzed_vuln.description: `get_coffset()` calls `blosc_getitem(coffsets, nchunk, 1, &offset)` on attacker-controlled `coffsets` data from the frame without passing/validating the actual compressed buffer length. `blosc_getitem` is invoked with implicit `srcsize=INT32_MAX`, so `_blosc_getitem`/`blosc_d` trust header fields and read 4-byte `cbytes` via `sw32_(src)` past the real end of the fuzzer input, causing the heap OOB read.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: In `decompress_frame_fuzzer`, a malformed in-memory frame is supplied where the offsets chunk (`coffsets`) is truncated/inconsistent but still reaches `frame_get_lazychunk -> get_coffset`. Because `get_coffset` uses size-unaware `blosc_getitem` (instead of a size-bounded path like `blosc2_getitem_ctx` with real `srcsize`), crafted chunk metadata drives decompression to read beyond the provided buffer. Trigger requires reaching chunk-offset extraction for some `nchunk` with invalid/truncated coffsets payload.
